about.summary: S3 functions for management, analysis, interpolation and plotting of time series used in hydrology and related environmental sciences. In particular, this package is highly oriented to hydrological modelling tasks. The focus of this package has been put in providing a collection of tools useful for the daily work of hydrologists (although an effort was made to optimise each function as much as possible, functionality has had priority over speed). name: r-hydrotsm
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.8-6" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-hydrotsm
  version: "{{ version|replace("-", "_") }}"

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/hydroTSM_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/hydroTSM/hydroTSM_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2b72dffd97b275e8a9cd119f23ac4ac554cd77006b453f082a2f0b39131e89cc

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-classint
    - r-e1071
    - r-lattice
    - r-timechange
    - r-xts >=0.9_7
    - r-zoo >=1.7_2
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-classint
    - r-e1071
    - r-lattice
    - r-timechange
    - r-xts >=0.9_7
    - r-zoo >=1.7_2

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('hydroTSM')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('hydroTSM')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/hzambran/hydroTSM
  dev_url: https://github.com/hzambran/hydroTSM
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  summary: S3 functions for management, analysis, interpolation and plotting of time series used in hydrology and related environmental sciences. In particular, this package is highly oriented to hydrological modelling tasks. The focus of this package has been put in providing a collection of tools useful for the daily
    work of hydrologists (although an effort was made to optimise each function as much as possible, functionality has had priority over speed). Bugs / comments / questions / collaboration of any kind are very welcomed, and in particular, datasets that can be included in this package for academic purposes.
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2'

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - c-brendel
